sloka: जानक्या परुषं वाक्यमेवमुक्तो दशाननः ।जज्वाल सहसा कोपच्चितास्थ इव पावकः ।। ५.५८.७३ ।।।।
transliteration: jānakyā paruṣaṁ vākyamevamukto daśānanaḥ ।jajvāla sahasā kopaccitāstha iva pāvakaḥ ।। 5.58.73 ।।।।

translations.english: "Thus addressed harshly by Janaki, the tenheaded Ravana blazed up in anger suddenly like the flame of the funeral pyre.
